questions.q: Why do teams commonly connect Salesforce to a data warehouse?
options: Because Salesforce cannot store any data
To join CRM data with other systems such as billing and product usage, keep long-term history, and feed machine learning
Because warehouses replace Salesforce entirely
Only to reduce the number of Salesforce users
questions.explain: Warehouses are where cross-system joins, deep history, and ML workloads live, while Salesforce remains the CRM system of record.

questions.q: What is the main characteristic of zero-copy data federation?
options: It copies every table nightly into Salesforce
It deletes the external data after use
It only works with CSV files
Data 360 queries external data where it lives instead of copying it
questions.explain: Zero-copy federation accesses data in the external system without storing a copy, though optional caching may be enabled for query federation.

questions.q: According to Salesforce documentation, how does file federation differ from query federation?
options: Data 360 reads the external storage layer directly with its own compute, avoiding external compute fees
File federation sends every query to the warehouse's compute
File federation only works for Salesforce objects
There is no difference
questions.explain: Query federation runs on the external system's compute; file federation reads storage directly and is recommended when supported.

questions.q: A pipeline that copies Opportunity records into the warehouse every night is which pattern?
options: Zero-copy data sharing
Write-back
Extract and load
Query federation
questions.explain: Extract and load copies objects on a schedule, giving full history at the cost of pipelines to maintain and data that is as fresh as the last load.

questions.q: Before pushing a warehouse-calculated churn score into a Salesforce field, what should you agree on first?
options: The color of the dashboard
Which team's laptop runs the job
Which system owns that field, so warehouse and CRM do not overwrite each other
The name of the quarterly report
questions.explain: Write-back changes CRM data, so field ownership must be agreed to avoid conflicting updates.
